influences.name: Jack Rusch
influences.context: The sound is shaped by my collaboration with Jack Rusch, who I first found on Instagram when he was making trap beats in Toronto. Now he's working with Beyoncé. We've both evolved so much, and this album feels like the culmination of that shared growth.
